# Read in the daily temperature data

Note these cleaned and filtered (>=20hrs of coverage/day) daily data were generated using the `1_summarize_daily_temperatures.Rmd` script. In this script, we'll fill gaps in the time series by borrowing from other sensors, produce some figures for collaborators, and then export a cleaned csv for downstream analyses.

```{r}
lter4 <- read_csv(here("cleaned_data", "LTER4_daily_summary_20hr_filter.csv")) 
```

# Examine gaps in LTER4

Get a list of all gaps across forereef sensors

```{r}
lter4 %>%
  filter(reef_type_code == "FOR") %>%
  mutate(Sensor = paste0(Site, "_", sensor_depth_m, "m")) %>% 
  arrange(Sensor, Date) %>%
  group_by(Site, sensor_depth_m, Sensor) %>% 
  # get number of days between each observation (would be 1 if no days between)
  mutate(Gap_days = as.numeric(Date - lag(Date)) - 1) %>%
  filter(Gap_days > 0) %>%
  mutate(Gap_start = Date - Gap_days,
         Gap_end = Date - 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Site, sensor_depth_m, Gap_start, Gap_end, Gap_days) -> gap_table
```

See in `gap_table` that there are only 5 gaps to fill at 10m, most of which are small (1-2 days), and only one of which is big (16 days). Write this to a csv for collaborators:

```{r}
gap_table %>% 
  filter(sensor_depth_m == 10) %>% 
  write_csv(here("cleaned_data", "lter4_10m_data_gaps.csv"))
```

# Fill large gap with 20 m sensor

LTER 4 20m has data for the largest gap in the 10m time series. We'll borrow from that timeseries to gap fill.

```{r}
# pull out the 10 m and 20 m forereef sensors
lter4 %>% 
  filter(reef_type_code == "FOR", sensor_depth_m == 10) %>% 
  select(Date, Mean_T_C, Max_T_C, Min_T_C) -> lter4_10m

lter4 %>% 
  filter(reef_type_code == "FOR", sensor_depth_m == 20) %>% 
  # rename temperatures to note they are 20m
  select(Date, Mean_20m = Mean_T_C, Max_20m = Max_T_C, Min_20m = Min_T_C) -> lter4_20m
```

Get the monthly average difference between the two depths (difference varies seasonally), which we can use as a correction factor when gap filling using the 20m data

```{r}
# average difference between 10 m and 20 m for each month of the year (from days when both were recording)
lter4_10m %>% 
  # use inner_join to just get dates they share
  inner_join(lter4_20m, by = "Date") %>% 
  group_by(Month = month(Date)) %>% 
  summarize(Mean_offset = mean(Mean_T_C - Mean_20m),
            Max_offset = mean(Max_T_C - Max_20m),
            Min_offset = mean(Min_T_C - Min_20m)) -> offsets
```

Fill gaps

```{r}
# make a row for every day so the gaps show up as NAs, then fill them from 20 m + the monthly offset
tibble(Date = seq(min(lter4_10m$Date), 
                  max(lter4_10m$Date), by = "day")) %>% 
  left_join(lter4_10m, by = "Date") %>% 
  left_join(lter4_20m, by = "Date") %>% 
  # get a date column to join date-specific offsets
  mutate(Month = month(Date)) %>% 
  left_join(offsets, by = "Month") %>% 
  # make a "source" column so it's clear when data are from 20m (in cases where there are no 10m data but there are 20m data)
  mutate(Source = case_when(!is.na(Mean_T_C) ~ "LTER_4_10m",
                            !is.na(Mean_20m) ~ "filled_LTER_4_20m"),
         Mean_T_C = ifelse(is.na(Mean_T_C), 
                           Mean_20m + Mean_offset, # if 10m is NA, use the 20m value and add the offset--if 20m is also NA, will still be NA (will deal with those later)
                           Mean_T_C),
         Max_T_C = ifelse(is.na(Max_T_C), 
                          Max_20m + Max_offset, 
                          Max_T_C),
         Min_T_C = ifelse(is.na(Min_T_C), 
                          Min_20m + Min_offset, 
                          Min_T_C)) %>% 
  # then just get the columns we want (don't need 20m anymore)
  select(Date, Mean_T_C, Max_T_C, Min_T_C, Source) -> lter4_10m_filled
```
Check what got filled and what's still missing (should just be small gaps left)

```{r}
# check: what got filled and what's still missing?
lter4_10m_filled %>% 
  count(Source) # 15 filled days, 6,765 actual days, and 6 days remaining to be filled

# check dates that need filling
lter4_10m_filled %>% 
  filter(is.na(Mean_T_C))
```
